bugs.criterion: O plano Premium salvo é aplicado no perfil / O perfil recupera o plano persistido pelo backend
bugs.description: The frontend-facing dev server (port 3000, backend/server.js, which is what the browser actually calls via relative /api/* paths) has NO route for GET /api/subscriptions/{id}, GET /api/owner/status, or POST /api/owner/entitlement. It only implements /api/config, /api/usuario/status, /api/catalog/plans and /api/subscriptions (list/create). Any other /api/* path falls through to the static file handler and returns 404 {"error":"Arquivo não encontrado"}. As a result perfil/script.js's fetch to /api/subscriptions/{id} always 404s from the real frontend origin, so the profile page can never show the Premium badge/3-preview limit even though the subscription was created and IS retrievable directly from the FastAPI backend on :8001. The owner banner/entitlement flow in catalogo/script.js is equally broken from the frontend origin.
bugs.evidence: curl http://localhost:3000/api/subscriptions/sub_1789566864667 -> 404 {"error":"Arquivo não encontrado"}; curl http://localhost:8001/api/subscriptions/sub_1789566864667 -> 200 with the correct subscription body. curl http://localhost:3000/api/owner/status -> 404 same error (vs 401 JSON from :8001). Browser check profile-applies-premium-plan-badge-and-limit created a real premium subscription via POST /api/subscriptions, stored its id, reloaded /front-end/perfil/index.html and observed the profile stayed on 'PLANO GRATUITO' because the id lookup 404'd (network log captured: 'subscription fetch status via frontend origin 404').

bugs.criterion: Sem assinatura Premium o perfil mantém o limite Gratuito (esconde o selo)
bugs.description: front-end/perfil/style.css defines `.premium-badge { display: inline-flex; ... }` unconditionally. This author rule overrides the browser's default `[hidden]{display:none}` UA rule for the same element, so even though script.js correctly sets/keeps the `hidden` attribute on #premium-badge when the plan is Gratuito, the badge renders visible anyway. The header plan-status text correctly says 'PLANO GRATUITO', but the public preview card still shows '✓ PREMIUM VERIFICADO'.
bugs.evidence: Browser check profile-defaults-to-free-plan-without-subscription: after clearing localStorage and reloading /front-end/perfil/index.html, getByTestId('profile-premium-badge') resolved to `✓ PREMIUM VERIFICADO` yet Playwright's toBeHidden() reported it as visible (screenshot confirms the neon badge rendered on the public card while the header still reads PLANO GRATUITO).

action_items.description: Could not fully exercise the owner-benefit criterion (active_owner for isbingsc@gmail.com, 403 for a non-owner). The Clerk account for isbingsc@gmail.com exists in the test instance, and a session can be minted server-side via clerk_backend_api (sessions.create + create_token), but tokens minted this way never carry an `azp` claim. backend/lib/auth.py always passes authorized_parties=[APP_URL] to authenticate_request, and clerk_backend_api's verifier unconditionally rejects any token with a missing azp claim when authorized_parties is set (see security/verifytoken.py: `if azp is None or azp not in options.authorized_parties: raise ...`). So every backend-minted test token is rejected with 401 before the owner-email comparison is reached, regardless of Origin headers. Only a real browser-completed Clerk sign-in bound to the app's origin would carry a valid azp, and completing that requires OTP email access that was not provided. Verified instead that the endpoints correctly require authentication (401 without/with invalid token) and confirmed via clerk-backend-api that the owner Clerk user already exists in this test instance.
